name: chromatic
description: Chromatic visual testing integration. Review visual changes, fix broken and flaky stories, check a branch is ready to merge, fix accessibility violations, and ask the Chromatic API anything else.

interface.shortDescription: Review Chromatic builds, fix what they find, and check a branch is ready to merge.
interface.longDescription: Connects Codex to the hosted Chromatic MCP server behind one OAuth login. Review the visual changes a build is waiting on, fix stories that failed to capture or keep flaking, turn reviewer comments into changes, fix accessibility violations at the component source, check whether a branch is ready to merge, and ask the Chromatic API anything else about your builds and projects.
defaultPrompt: What is the latest Chromatic build on this branch?
Fix the accessibility violations Chromatic found on this branch.
Is this branch ready to merge from Chromatic's side?
